pages.text: If you feel like you're moving slower after putting on your armor, that's fine. This is a unique feature of FreshCraft, where armor has logic.$(br)You will have to choose your armor wisely based on what you want to do right now:

Explore the world, kill the boss or clear the beds of weeds. But don't worry, there are many solutions to this problem, such as speed potions or a combination of heavy and light armor elements. The example is above.

pages.text: The weight of the armor also affects the fall, keep this in mind.$(br2)The weight of the armor depends on the material it is made of and the degree of protection it provides.$(br)You can't sleep in armor either. The exception is the «pajamas» - a comfortable armor in which you can go to bed.

Pajamas, for example, are leather armor.$(br2)Another weight reduction solution is the «Lightweight» enchantment. It is extremely rare, less common than the «Minding» itself. «Lightweight» reduces the weight of all armor worn by 50%. It is applied only on the breastplate.
Remember that some armor/clothing is lightweight or has no weight at all.
